messages:
Maria G.: Hey team — quick follow-up from tonight's latency spike. root cause still looks like KV cache thrash + fallback to cold-models. filing follow-ups now.
Dmitri: yup saw the same. KV eviction rate peaked at ~95% for a 30s window, then batching collapsed.
Carla: grabbing metrics now, will post grafana links.
oncall-bot: Incident RINF-2314 created by Maria G. — severity: sev2 — postmortem draft started https://redwood.internal/incidents/RINF-2314
Maria G.: noted. main ask: we should add targeted tests to prevent regression — short list proposal below. feedback?
Sam: +1. what are you thinking exactly?
Maria G.: 1) regression suite: small-state long-session test (simulate 1k concurrent sessions, median session length 8k tokens) 2) promptset: add the 'session-churn' prompt set to sanity checks 3) load test: ramp/burst tests with KV-cache warm/cold transitions 4) chaos drill: scheduler/eviction chaos (force GPU memory pressure)
Dmitri: agree. also add an alert to detect sustained KV eviction > 50% over 1m. currently we only alert on absolute OOMs.
Carla: created ticket RINF-2315 for regression suite work. assigning to @Carla for initial harness and @Sam for infra config. due: 2026-04-05.
Elaine: I'll own the promptset curation. will add ~40 examples that exercise long prefix reuse and short burst queries. PR target next week.
Sam: infra notes: need a synthetic workload generator that can replay per-session token patterns and simulate prefix reuse. I'll spin up a small harness in the test cluster and share config.
Maria G.: action summary (copying into postmortem):
- Action A: RINF-2315 regression harness (owner: Carla) — due 2026-04-05
- Action B: RINF-2316 promptset additions (owner: Elaine) — due 2026-03-31
- Action C: RINF-2317 load/eviction alert + dashboard (owner: Dmitri) — due 2026-03-26
- Action D: RINF-2318 chaos drill plan + runbook (owner: Sam) — due 2026-04-09
Dmitri: noted RXs. I'll add the alert and a runbook snippet. linking the query here:
```
sum(rate(kv_evictions[1m])) by (cluster)
/ sum(rate(kv_requests[1m])) by (cluster) > 0.5
```
Carla: rough harness commands (WIP):
```
make test-harness SESSION_COUNT=1000 TARGET=dev-cluster --pattern=session-churn
```
Maria G.: also proposing a weekly 30min drill for 6 weeks post-mortem: rotate oncall + infra + ml to run the chaos drill and validate regression suite. who can volunteer?
Elaine: I'll join the first two drills.
Sam: I'll schedule infra window and a calendar invite.
Dmitri: I'll take ownership of the alert follow-through and verify post-deploy metrics.
Maria G.: perfect. I'll update the postmortem with these AIs and ping product + SRE for visibility. thanks all. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Reminder set: RINF-2315 check-in in 7 days (automated).
